note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this book was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording the first edition carried; the UBS credit line this file once owed is no longer owed for this work.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions and the author's own paraphrases left as prose, verses recast to another person (the reader's vow or confession), and the chapter title of «እኔ ምንኛ ጎስቋላ ሰው ነኝ!», which stays Murray's title.

Judgement calls: Isaiah 27:3 — OWB reads «በየጊዜው» (continually) where Murray argues from «every moment», so the verse is quoted as OWB has it and his question carries the gloss. Luke 1:37 serves «with God nothing shall be impossible» (said to Mary), as OWB words it. Mark 14:29 and Luke 22:33 are quoted as OWB pieces joined with '…' under the author's double citation.
